name: io.github.rigshare-hq/rigshare
description: Rent GPUs, robots, drones, and construction gear on RIGShare; also onboards equipment owners.

environmentVariables.description: RIGShare API key (Bearer format). Required for the authenticated tools (booking, listing, session, quote, availability, cancel, extend, usage, and draft management). Without it, the public read-only tools (search, get equipment, list categories, owner onboarding) still work. Create a key at https://www.rigshare.app/enterprise (API keys need a Pro or Enterprise plan) or contact support@rigshare.app.
